items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Pastor Sam, Bill told me yesterday... I think it'd be a kind of, I'm talking water between him and Bill.

ctx.x: I couldn't bring myself to go see him when he had that chance, I just...
But you know Bill... Bill Stopper with his...
And what is this? You know that chorus, huh? He's imitating somebody, you know. He's not the real man.
